checksumScope: canonical Git blob bytes at each migration sourceSha, or productionSha when sourceSha is omitted

rollback.evidence: scripts/product-control-dryrun.mjs rollback-zero proof and Website 6 PostgreSQL 16 acceptance
Website 6 independently reproduced 69 privileges, applied the revoke-only migration twice, and converged to the reviewed 33-privilege boundary
Website 2 fresh PostgreSQL 16 managed apply-twice, accepted adversarial lifecycle/concurrency verifier, read-only privilege/count verifier, and rollback-zero proof

invariants: productionSha is the same TRUSTED_RELEASE_BASELINE recorded by CURRENT_PRODUCTION_STATE, ACTIVE_RELEASE_GRAPH, and FILE_OWNERSHIP.
Every dependency must exist and be applied before its dependent migration.
The dependency graph must be acyclic.
Checksums are computed from canonical Git blob bytes, not platform-normalized worktree line endings.
Every migration requires a non-empty rollback strategy, procedure, and verification evidence.
No migration in this DAG creates product, price, inventory, lot, COA, order, role, seed, or Care records.
